note:
R56 — gen7 kit selectors (Teams 2.6): the `stockteamjerseys` / `customteamjerseys` rows joined to the shipped kit textures
`rendering/jersey/texlib_<style>_<teamartid>_<variant>.rx2`, `rendering/pant/texlib_<style>_<teamartid>_<variant>.rx2` and
`rendering/sock/sock_<style>_<teamartid>_<variant>_cm.rx2` (`.rpsgl` on PS3) on NHL 11–Legacy (both consoles where loose). Read-only.

Per title: rows, columns, value censuses (style / variant / fevariant / jerseyindex / isdefault / hastie / islightcolor), the join rate
per family under the (style, teamartid, variant) key and the alternatives (jerseyindex, fevariant), residuals both ways (rows without a
file; kit files without a row = unused shipped kits per team art id), teams without any row, and the team → art id consistency
(`teamid` → `exhibitionteams.artid` == `teamartid`).
Usage: python r56_gen7_kit_selector_join.py <out.json>
